AssetHoard v0.1.8 Release Notes

Semantic search, grid zoom, and performance gains

Introducing semantic search - find assets by describing what you're looking for instead of relying on exact names or tags. Alongside that, a new onboarding screen helps first-time users get started, and under the hood we've landed more meaningful performance improvements to bundle loading and the import pipeline.

🔍 Semantic Search (New)

Turn on semantic search in Settings -> Experiments. It requires a one time download of ~400mb which includes 2 open source ML models that help make sense of text & images.

  • Natural language search — Find assets by describing what you're looking for, not just by name or tag
  • Automatic index sync — The search index stays up to date automatically: deleted assets are removed, restored assets are re-added, and category changes trigger re-indexing
  • Tweak settings — Like relevancy threashold, and show similarity scores to tweak your experience

🎨 UI & Navigation

  • Grid zoom — Use Ctrl+Scroll to resize asset cards on the fly, or adjust with the grid size slider
  • New keyboard shortcuts — Added shortcuts for asset selection, navigation, and switching between views
  • Empty library onboarding — A new welcome screen guides you through getting started when your library is empty
  • Better expanded previews — Expanded preview modals now properly fill available vertical space
  • Search bar focus fix — The \ key now correctly focuses the search bar
  • Virtualized sidebar tree — Sidebar bundle tree is virtualized for smoother scrolling with large bundle counts

🚀 Performance

  • Faster nested bundle loading — Optimized with batch processing and deduplication, eliminating redundant database queries
  • Lighter bundle responses — Bundles load opimization, 35% quicker to open a bundle
  • Faster imports — Import pipeline releases database locks earlier, improving responsiveness during large imports
  • Background auto-backup — Auto-backup no longer blocks UI's first paint, making the app load quicker

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Network drive drag-and-drop — Dragging files from network drives (NAS) no longer crashes the app
  • Instant import visibility — Imported assets now appear in the UI immediately — no manual refresh needed
  • Selection marquee fix — Selection marquee now calculates the correct row at smaller window sizes
  • Bundle cover images — Cover images work correctly for audio-only bundles and their parents
  • Unity thumbnail loading — Unity thumbnails load properly in Settings
  • Reveal in file explorer — Quickly open any asset's location in your system file manager
  • Persistent preview controls — Preview panel controls no longer disappear when the panel is resized small

Known Bugs

  • Synology NAS file dragging — if a file is located on a Synology NAS, dragging it out of AssetHoard isn't working. This is due to a low-level windows security issue. We are aware and are currently working on a fix

May your assets be organised and your bundles be nested.

Happy hoarding!
Stability & speed improvements, and Watched folders rewrite
A rewritten watched folders system, database stability fixes, snappier thumbnails and waveforms, and the first steps of a UI refresh.

AssetHoard v0.1.7 Release Notes

Stability & speed improvements, and Watched folders rewrite

AssetHoard should feel like it just works. Fast imports, seamless navigation, and nothing getting in your way. This release moves us closer to that goal with watched folder management rewrite, snappier thumbnail and waveform handling, database stability fixes, and the first steps of a broader UI refresh.

👁️ Watched Folders

  • Manage from anywhere — Add, edit, and remove watched folders directly from the bundle details panel or the context menu via a new dedicated modal
  • Visual indicators — Watched folder badges now appear on bundle cards and list rows so you can see at a glance which bundles are being watched
  • Safer deletes — Deleting or restoring bundles now correctly handles their associated watched folders

🔧 Stability

  • Database lock fix — Resolved several locking issues that could cause errors under load
  • Better file error handling — PSD and GIF files that fail to process now show user-friendly error messages
  • Application-wide logging — Added more logging throughout the app for easier troubleshooting
  • Lazy generation for large images — Oversized images no longer trigger heavy upfront processing, reducing memory usage
  • Parallel waveform generation — Audio waveforms are now generated in parallel with progress reporting

🖼️ Previews & File Support

  • Progress feedback — Fixed a bug where thumbnail generation wasn't showing progress, make the import look like it stalled
  • Aseprite ICC support — Improvements to Aseprite colour profile management

📂 Import

  • Bundle cache refresh — Importing assets into an existing bundle now properly refreshes the parent bundle cache
  • Smoother close animation — The importer window animates smoothly into the notification area when minimising, making it clearer the import has moved to the noficiation area

🔍 Search

  • Better loading feedback — Search results now show a clearer loading state while results are being fetched
  • Improved input handling — Search input behaviour is more reliable and responsive
  • Enter to search — Removed instant search filtering in bundles, commit the search by pressing enter

🎨 UI & Usability

We're kicking off a broader visual refresh of AssetHoard's interface - this release is the first step, with a handful of minor styling updates and usability improvements. Expect more to come in future releases.

  • Various styling tweaks — Small visual polish of the sidebar including a small restyle
  • Sidebar count toggle — Show or hide item counts in the sidebar via a new setting
  • UI Text Size Adjustment — Text Size can be adjusted between small, medium, and large
  • More grid sizes — The grid size slider now supports sizes 1 through 8 for finer control over your layout
  • Smarter back button — The mouse back button now closes modals instead of navigating away from the current page
  • Delete confirmation spinner — A loading spinner on the delete confirmation button gives clear feedback while the operation runs
  • Accessibility improvements — Added aria-labels to sidebar and modal buttons for better screen reader support
  • Bundle name filtering in sidebar — Filter the bundles in the sidebar by name

Smoother performance, undo improvements, and 3D animation playback
Faster startup and post-import performance, reliable undo, a new Play All option for 3D model animations, and sort assets by file creation date.

AssetHoard v0.1.9 Release Notes

Smoother performance, undo improvements, and 3D animation playback

This release focuses on making AssetHoard feel snappier and more responsive. Background threads no longer pile up after large imports, semantic search runs without blocking other operations, and the app starts up faster. On the UI side, undo is now more reliable, 3D models get a new Play All animation option, and you can sort assets by the date they were created on disk.

🚀 Performance

  • Faster post-import cleanup — Background threads no longer accumulate after imports, freeing up resources and preventing lock contention
  • Smoother semantic search — Read-only semantic operations no longer hold write locks, so searches don't block other work
  • Faster app startup — Semantic search settings now load asynchronously, keeping them out of the critical startup path

🎨 UI & Usability

  • Sort by file creation date — A new "Date Created" sort option lets you order assets by when the file was originally created on disk
  • Play All animations — 3D model previews now include a Play All option to cycle through every animation on the model
  • File type badges — Bundle details now show colour-coded file type labels for a clearer breakdown of what's inside

  • Reliable undo — Ctrl+Z is now responsive with proper feedback so you know when an undo action has been applied
  • Cover save feedback — A loading spinner on cover capture and save buttons gives clear feedback when processing large images
  • Indexing notification toggle — A new "Show Indexing Notifications" toggle in semantic search settings lets you silence indexing progress popups

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Auto-backup timing — Resolved an issue where auto-backup could run at an inopportune time and briefly lock the database
